meeting.review.title: Contextual word review
meeting.review.hint: Select a model and press Check. The model reviews the original text with its context; all suggestions are shown. Green, underlined words mark changes. You can save a corrected version; the original text and audio times are preserved.
meeting.review.modelsEmpty: No installed models were found. Check the local Ollama installation.
meeting.review.modelRemote: This model uses a remote service and cannot be selected for local review.
meeting.review.modelNotLanguage: This model does not support text generation.
meeting.review.modelMetadata: The model's local information could not be verified.
meeting.review.modelChanged: The model identity changed or could not be verified. Refresh the model list and select it again.
meeting.review.requiresCheck: Review this change together with its context.
meeting.review.sourceNotFound: The original phrase was not found in this turn; no position was assigned.
meeting.review.ambiguousSource: The original phrase occurs more than once; its intended position is unknown.
meeting.review.overlappingEdits: This proposal overlaps another change; no position was assigned in the text.
meeting.review.unsupportedCharacters: The proposal contains unsupported characters; no position was assigned in the text.
meeting.review.invalidOutput: The model response could not be parsed into word changes. You can read the response below.
meeting.review.outputTruncated: The model response was cut at the display limit. This response cannot be saved.
meeting.review.cannotSave: This response cannot be saved because it is incomplete or not every proposal maps to the original text. The model's proposals remain visible.
meeting.review.saved: The corrected version was saved. The original text was preserved.
meeting.review.tokenExpired: This suggestion's save period expired or its proof is invalid. Press Check again.
meeting.review.conflict: A newer correction was saved for this turn. Refresh the page and review again; the existing version was not changed.
meeting.review.savedInvalid: The saved correction could not be verified against this original text. The original is shown.
meeting.review.unchanged: The model suggested no word changes. This does not confirm that the transcript is error-free.
meeting.review.rejected: The suggestions did not pass the limited-edit checks. The original text was kept.
meeting.review.unavailable: Local text review is not ready. Check its setup before trying again; the original transcript remains readable.
meeting.review.timeout: Word review reached its time limit. The original text was kept; you can try again.
meeting.review.invalid: A consistent correction suggestion could not be obtained. The original text was kept.
meeting.review.tooLong: This speech turn is too long to review in one request. You can inspect the original text and source audio.
meeting.review.changed: The source text changed during review. Refresh the page to see the current result.
meeting.review.notReady: Meeting analysis must finish before words can be reviewed.
meeting.review.forbidden: Word review requires permission to read meetings and run analysis.
meeting.review.missing: The meeting transcript is no longer available. Check its current status in the meeting list.
meeting.review.failed: Word review could not finish. Check your connection and try again; the original text is unchanged.
meeting.audio.title: Source audio
meeting.audio.hint: Up to 30 seconds of the source. Press play; this audio is neither cleaned nor separated by speaker. Multiple channels are mixed together.
meeting.audio.empty: There is no playable source section for this transcript row.
meeting.audio.unavailable: The source audio has expired or can no longer be read. You can continue reviewing the transcript.
meeting.audio.forbidden: You do not have permission to listen to this recording. Check your session and access permissions.
meeting.audio.notReady: The audio upload is not complete. Try again after it finishes.
meeting.audio.invalid: The audio section could not be read in a valid format. Retry, or review another section if the problem continues.
meeting.audio.failed: The audio section could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
meeting.renameIdentityHint: Renaming does not change voice identity or correct an incorrect speaker assignment.
meeting.reason.insufficientSpeech: Not enough clean speech evidence was collected for persistent memory.
meeting.reason.inconsistentAudio: A single consistent speaker could not be verified in the selected audio sections.
meeting.reason.clippedAudio: Distortion in the audio level prevented this section from being accepted as memory evidence.
meeting.reason.invalidAudio: The audio section did not pass the memory quality check.
meeting.reason.insufficientMargin: Several saved people produced similar results; the difference was too small to choose one.
meeting.reason.belowMatch: The similarity was not sufficient to select a saved person confidently.
meeting.reason.overlapConflict: Different groups speaking at the same time could not be assigned to one person.
meeting.reason.reconciliation: The grouping of speakers within this meeting remained uncertain.
meeting.reason.memoryDisabled: Automatic memory enrollment is disabled for this meeting.
meeting.reason.matched: The voice evidence matched an existing profile; listen to the relevant section to check the result if needed.
meeting.reason.enrolled: Enough clean evidence was verified for a new person and a persistent profile was created.
meeting.reason.noProfiles: There was no saved profile available for comparison.
meeting.reason.unknown: The voice was considered a candidate for a person distinct from the saved profiles.
meeting.intro: Record with your microphone or upload an audio file to see who said what. Recognized people are linked to their existing profiles.
meeting.uploadHint: Choose a recording and start uploading. Analysis is queued after the upload completes.
meeting.limits: WAV or FLAC · up to 2 GiB and 4 hours. Contents and duration are validated on the server.
meeting.countHint: Total participants is an upper bound; some people may stay silent. The speaker count is an exact expectation for the whole recording. Leave unknown values blank.
meeting.remember: Remember new people with enough clean speech
meeting.memoryPermission: New people will not be saved because you do not have profile write permission.
meeting.memoryHint: Short turns still appear in the transcript. Separate turns from the same person accumulate; saving a profile requires more than 20 seconds of clean speech and identity checks.
meeting.readOnly: You can view meetings. Uploading or changing recordings requires run permission.
meeting.retention: Source audio is kept for 7 days, transcripts and meeting results for 30 days. Incomplete uploads expire after 24 hours. Saved people follow their own profile lifecycle.
meeting.statusHint.queued: The recording is waiting for analysis. The server job continues if you close this page.
meeting.statusHint.running: Speakers are being separated and speech transcribed. Completed duration updates below.
meeting.statusHint.finalizing: Speaker matches and persistent memory are being finalized.
meeting.countMismatch: The detected speaker count differs from your expectation. People were not merged to force the count; review the speakers and transcript.
meeting.countSummary: Participant upper bound: {participants} · Expected active speakers: {speakers}
meeting.resumeHint: Select the same file to resume. Saved parts are compared with it before the remainder uploads. The original unuploaded remainder cannot be verified in advance.
meeting.cancelHint: Uploading or analysis stops. Existing partial results remain visible; saved speaker profiles are kept.
meeting.deleteHint: The meeting source and transcript are deleted. People already saved in memory are kept; you can delete them separately on the Speakers page.
meeting.sourceUnavailable: The source audio is no longer retained. Upload a new recording to run analysis again.
meeting.pollPaused: Automatic checks paused after connection errors. The server job may still be running; refresh to check.
meeting.pendingHint: This person's transcript is retained. A persistent profile requires enough consistent, verified speech.
meeting.ambiguousHint: The voice could not be assigned confidently to one profile; no new profile was created.
meeting.localNameHint: This name appears only in this meeting; naming does not create a voice profile.
meeting.profileNameHint: The saved profile name is updated and used for the same person in later meetings.
meeting.profileDeleted: This person's saved profile was deleted.
meeting.provisional: Provisional results: speaker matches and text may change as analysis finishes.
meeting.error.counts: The speaker count cannot exceed the total participant count.
meeting.error.validation_error: Check the name, optional counts and file. Counts must be whole numbers from 1 to 1000.
meeting.error.invalid_audio: The file is not valid, decodable audio. Choose a valid WAV or FLAC recording.
meeting.error.unsupported_audio: Only WAV and FLAC recordings are supported; renaming the extension does not convert a file.
meeting.error.audio_limit: The recording exceeds the size or duration limit: up to 2 GiB and 4 hours.
meeting.error.not_found: The meeting was not found or you do not have access.
meeting.error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action. If permissions changed, sign out and back in.
meeting.error.idempotency_conflict: This attempt conflicts with different content. Check the existing meeting or start a new upload.
meeting.error.recording_expired: This upload expired. Upload a new meeting recording.
meeting.error.recording_unavailable: The source audio is no longer available. Upload a new recording.
meeting.error.upload_limit: The active upload limit was reached. Complete or cancel an existing upload.
meeting.error.storage_limit: Meeting storage is full. Delete unneeded meeting recordings and try again.
meeting.error.source_mismatch: The selected file does not match the saved parts. Select the same source file for this meeting.
meeting.error.upload_ack_invalid: The server upload acknowledgement could not be verified. Uploading stopped; retry to check the saved parts.
meeting.error.upload_incomplete: The file has not fully uploaded. Resume the upload.
meeting.error.upload_order_conflict: The part sequence changed. Retry to resume from the server's saved position.
meeting.error.chunk_hash_mismatch: The audio part could not be verified. Check your connection and retry the upload.
meeting.error.meeting_state_conflict: The meeting status changed. Refresh to see its current state.
meeting.error.name_conflict: This name was changed elsewhere. Refresh the result and edit again.
meeting.error.inference_unavailable: The meeting models or selected device are not ready. Retry when the runtime is ready.
meeting.error.job_timeout: Analysis exceeded its processing time limit. You can retry while the source is retained.
meeting.error.worker_interrupted: Analysis was interrupted and automatic retries ended. You can retry while the source is retained.
meeting.error.unexpected: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and retry; uploading resumes from verified parts.
login.subtitle: Use your internal application identity.
login.title: Sign in
login.adminUnavailable: The local administrator account is not ready. Complete administrator setup or sign in with your username and password.
login.adminDisabled: Local administrator sign-in is not enabled at this address. Sign in with your username and password.
login.error: The username or password is invalid.
login.unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
common.forbidden: You do not have permission to access this page.
home.title: Your workspace
home.intro: Upload a meeting recording to see each speaker's words, give people names and reuse saved voice profiles across meetings.
home.scope: Meetings accepts WAV/FLAC recordings and shows speaker matches alongside the transcript. Speakers manages saved voice profiles; Identify voice compares a single-speaker sample. Recognition quality must be measured with representative recordings.
speaker.profiles.title: Speakers
speaker.profiles.intro: Profiles are reused across analyses. Identification does not change existing profiles.
speaker.profiles.name: Speaker name or nickname
speaker.profiles.emptyHint: Start with a clean recording of the first person. Each speaker is stored in a separate profile.
speaker.profiles.deleteHint: The profile and its voice samples will be excluded from identification. Unused application copies are cleaned up; your original file stays unchanged.
speaker.profiles.readOnly: You can view profiles. Adding a voice sample requires profile write, analysis run and analysis read permissions.
speaker.analysis.title: Identify voice
speaker.analysis.intro: Compare a recording against all eligible saved speakers. Unknown or ambiguous voices do not automatically create profiles.
speaker.analysis.readOnly: You can view analyses. Starting a new analysis requires run permission.
speaker.audio.single: Choose a sample with a single speaker.
speaker.audio.enrollHint: A clean 20–30 second recording is recommended. At least 10 seconds of usable speech is required. A sample added to an existing profile must match that person.
speaker.audio.identifyHint: At least 3 seconds of usable speech is required. Prefer a longer, clean recording from a different session.
speaker.audio.limits: WAV or FLAC · up to 50 MiB · up to 120 seconds. File contents are validated on the server.
speaker.audio.retention: Unused and identification-only copies are kept for 24 hours. Profile samples are retained until the profile is deleted.
speaker.submit.pending: The analysis is queued after upload. Its result will appear on the job page.
speaker.jobs.title: Analysis status
speaker.jobs.retention: Job history is kept for 7 days. Reopen a pending job through its link to check progress.
speaker.jobs.queuedHint: The job is waiting in the queue. One analysis runs on the GPU at a time.
speaker.jobs.runningHint: The audio is being checked and speaker features are being extracted.
speaker.jobs.pollingPaused: Automatic status checks have paused. The server job may still be running; you can check again.
speaker.jobs.resumeHint: Refreshing this page does not restart the job. This link retrieves its saved status.
speaker.result.title: Result
speaker.result.deletedHint: The profile from this historical result is no longer active or used for identification.
speaker.result.scoreHint: Cosine similarity is a comparison score, not confidence percent or an accuracy probability. These are pilot thresholds.
speaker.reason.enrolled: The audio passed quality checks and was added to the profile.
speaker.reason.matched: The best candidate exceeded the match threshold and required candidate margin.
speaker.reason.no_profiles: There are no saved profiles eligible for comparison with this model revision.
speaker.reason.below_new_threshold: Similarity to saved profiles is below the unknown threshold. No new profile was created.
speaker.reason.below_match_threshold: Similarity did not reach the match threshold. No profile was changed.
speaker.reason.insufficient_margin: The top two candidates are too close. This voice was not assigned to a person.
speaker.reason.other: The decision was produced using the model's recorded thresholds.
speaker.error.validation_error: Check the fields and selected file.
speaker.error.invalid_audio: The file is not decodable audio. Choose a valid WAV/FLAC file.
speaker.error.unsupported_audio: Only WAV and FLAC files are supported.
speaker.error.audio_limit: The file exceeds the limit: up to 50 MiB and 120 seconds.
speaker.error.not_found: The record was not found or you do not have access to it.
speaker.error.idempotency_conflict: This attempt key was used with different content. Select the file again to start a new attempt.
speaker.error.recording_expired: The uploaded copy has expired or was deleted. Submitting again starts a new upload.
speaker.error.recording_in_use: An active profile or job is using this recording.
speaker.error.sample_limit: This profile has reached the limit of 20 samples. No sample was added.
speaker.error.profile_limit: This enrollment was rejected under the profile limit in effect at the time. No new profile was created. You can now start a new enrollment.
speaker.error.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
speaker.error.insufficient_speech: Not enough usable speech was found. Try a longer, clean recording.
speaker.error.inconsistent_audio: The audio windows are inconsistent. Use a clean recording of one person.
speaker.error.clipped_audio: The audio is heavily clipped. Reduce the microphone level and record again.
speaker.error.target_mismatch: The sample did not match the selected speaker closely enough. The existing profile was not changed.
speaker.error.profile_unavailable: The target profile is no longer active. Select a profile again.
speaker.error.model_mismatch: The recording and profile model revisions do not match. An administrator must check the configuration.
speaker.error.inference_unavailable: The local voice model or GPU is not ready. Start a new job once the runtime is ready.
speaker.error.job_timeout: The analysis exceeded its execution time limit. Start a new job with a shorter file.
speaker.error.worker_interrupted: The worker was interrupted and the retry limit was reached. You can start a new job.
speaker.error.recording_unavailable: The source audio copy for this analysis is unavailable. Upload the file again.
speaker.error.unexpected: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again; retrying the same submission does not create a duplicate job.
workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.memoryHint: Saved profiles help recognize people across meetings.
home.subtitle: Your conversations, your speakers, right where you left off.
home.heroBody: Turn your meeting recording into a readable transcript. See who said what, and remember familiar voices.
home.workflowTitle: Your meeting memory, in three steps
home.step.uploadHint: Choose your meeting's WAV or FLAC file.
home.step.reviewHint: Review the speaker transcript and give people names.
home.step.rememberHint: New speakers are remembered when enough consistent speech is available.
meeting.historyHint: Your recordings, analysis status and results in one place.
meeting.emptyHint: Your meeting will appear here when you send a microphone recording or audio file for analysis.
meeting.transcriptHint: Follow who said what, in conversation order.
meeting.speakersHint: Review speakers, add names and check their memory status.
login.storyBody: Separate speakers, see what was said and recognize familiar voices in the next meeting.
login.adminHint: One-step administrator access for local development.
microphone.sourceHint: Choose an audio file or record here with your microphone. Speakers and a transcript are prepared after recording ends.
microphone.title: Microphone recording
microphone.scopeHint: Records sound heard by your selected microphone. Teams or computer audio is not captured automatically.
microphone.keepOpen: Keep this page open and your device awake until recording and transfer finish. Maximum 4 hours or 2 GiB; available disk space may impose an earlier limit.
microphone.limitReached: The duration or size limit was reached. Recording stopped automatically; the completed audio is being sent for analysis.
microphone.retryHint: Your recording is retained on this page. Check your connection and try again. Leaving the page or cancelling releases this temporary copy; you will need to record again.
microphone.error.insecure_context: For microphone access, open this app on localhost on this computer or over a secure HTTPS connection.
microphone.error.unsupported: This browser does not support secure microphone recording. Use an up-to-date browser or upload an audio file.
microphone.error.permission_denied: Microphone permission was denied. Enable the microphone in your browser's site settings and try again.
microphone.error.device_unavailable: No microphone is available, or another application is using it. Check your microphone connection.
microphone.error.device_interrupted: The microphone disconnected or recording was suspended. Incomplete audio was not sent for analysis; start a new recording.
microphone.error.buffer_full: Audio could not be written to disk fast enough. Recording stopped to prevent data loss. Check disk space and device load.
microphone.error.recording_limit: The recording reached its duration or size limit. It was not sent for analysis; make shorter recordings.
microphone.error.storage_full: The browser's temporary recording storage is full. Free disk space and try again; incomplete audio was not sent for analysis.
microphone.error.storage_unavailable: The browser's temporary recording storage is unavailable. Check browser settings or upload an audio file.
microphone.error.empty_recording: No audio has been recorded yet. Check your microphone and record for a little longer.
microphone.error.capture_failed: Microphone recording could not finish. Check your microphone and browser permissions, then try again.
